## Project Context
This is a planetary wisdom time capsule project focused on human flourishing and addressing civilizational risks. The goal is to create a comprehensive knowledge repository that can guide humanity toward avoiding collapse while maximizing flourishing.

## Key Principles
- Focus on evidence-based solutions and wisdom
- Prioritize accessibility and actionable guidance
- Maintain hope while honestly assessing challenges
- Design for scalability and future AI integration
- Center around the interconnectedness of all life

## Content Guidelines
- When generating content, emphasize practical steps individuals and organizations can take
- Include diverse perspectives from global wisdom traditions
- Balance local actionability with planetary-scale thinking
- Reference authoritative sources and latest research
- Design for multiple audiences (policymakers, activists, general public)

## Technical Guidelines
- Build with accessibility in mind
- Optimize for performance and mobile devices
- Structure code for easy content updates and AI integration
- Use semantic HTML and clear documentation
- Plan for future interactive features and data visualization
